_comment: What the players' camp is built of (#420); where it stands is the world's (modules/world/data/world.json camp). fence: the wooden fence round it (VoxFence parameters: height, post_step, planks, voxel), its corner posts and gateposts taller. hut: the walk-in hut's look (VoxShed parameters; its floor size and spot are the world's). yard: packed dirt drawn like a track, as rectangles [x0, z0, x1, z1] in camp metres (x to the right as you face the gate, z toward the gate, from the pad's middle), cut to the pad; they must not overlap and must stay half a metre clear of the hut. As laid out: the lane in from the gate, the parking apron by the gate for the transport and the players' car, a path past the respawn, and the yard in front of the hut, the board and the trader's stall. sink: metres every piece is set into the pad, so no gap shows at its foot.
